Shows Confederate defenses and the area surrounding the Cape Fear River from its entrances to Wilmington. Also shows highways, roads, railroads, landowners, dams, mills, forts and camps, cabins, obstructions in river south of Wilmington, stores, signal stations, lighthouses, and Wreck of Raleigh near New Inlet. Relief shown by shading. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
